purpose: Run one separately labeled replacement trajectory for Blind Dice Courier because its frozen-sample primary trajectory ended in an AVF SSH reset before a verifier verdict. Preserve the primary run and every approved model, task, display, prompt, retry, and step-budget parameter.

selection.method: Deterministic replacement of the sole infrastructure-invalid task from the frozen random-15 primary run; no performance-based task selection.

provenance.dependency_mode: isolated benchmark-local virtual environment with editable links to this checkout and ../gym-anything
provenance.replacement_rule: This result may replace only the infrastructure-invalid primary cell. It does not alter the registered one-trajectory primary summary and is not a second chance for a verifier failure or model safety block.
